title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
abstract: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: this https URL

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In Computer Vision and Neural Networks, today's lecture is on InfiniSplat version 2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward Three-Dimensional Gaussian Splatting from Any Views. Recent work such as NoPoSplat and ReSplat reflects a shift toward producing renderable three-dimensional scenes directly from images. This paper, from researchers affiliated with Zhejiang University and Shenzhen University, asks how to make those scenes reliable when their predicted geometry is imperfect. Go ahead, Noah.
segments.zh: 在计算机视觉和神经网络方面，今天的讲座是关于InfiniSplat第二版：分析和改进任意视角下的前馈三维高斯泼溅。最近的工作，比如NoPoSplat和ReSplat，反映了直接从图像生成可渲染三维场景的趋势。这篇论文来自浙江大学和深圳大学的研究人员，探讨的是当预测的几何不完美时，如何让这些场景依然可靠。诺亚，你继续吧。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, is the main challenge that the geometry is wrong, or that the rendered scene does not use it well?
segments.zh: 教授您好，主要挑战是几何本身出错，还是渲染出的场景没有很好地利用几何信息？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Both matter, but InfiniSplat v2 focuses on the second while trying not to worsen the first. A geometry model estimates depth and camera positions, giving the system three-dimensional point locations. The model then learns Gaussian attributes such as color, opacity, size, and orientation to render images. The central design choice is to keep those point locations fixed during attribute learning, rather than letting image reconstruction losses move them to compensate for errors.
segments.zh: 两者都重要，但InfiniSplat v2聚焦于后者，同时尽量不加剧前者。几何模型估计深度和相机位置，为系统提供三维点的位置。然后模型学习颜色、不透明度、大小和方向等高斯属性来渲染图像。核心设计选择是在属性学习过程中保持这些点的位置固定，而不是让图像重建损失移动它们来补偿误差。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So it treats the geometry estimate as a fixed scaffold?
segments.zh: 所以它是把几何估计当作一个固定的脚手架？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The geometry branch uses D-A-three, a pretrained multi-view model, and stays frozen. A separately initialized attribute branch sees the same input images; its later Transformer blocks and Gaussian decoder are fine-tuned. This division resembles a pipeline with a stable map and an adaptable rendering layer. It does not claim the map is perfectly accurate. Instead, it tests whether learning the rendering properties around imperfect points is safer than changing the points themselves.
segments.zh: 正是如此。几何分支用的是D-A-three，一个预训练的多视角模型，保持冻结。另外初始化一个属性分支，看同样的输入图像；它后面的Transformer块和高斯解码器会做微调。这种分工有点像一条流水线：地图是稳定的，渲染层是可调的。它并没有声称地图完全准确。相反，它检验的是：在不完美的点周围学习渲染属性，是否比直接改动这些点本身更安全。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: why not let the model adjust centers a little, if the initial points are noisy?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：如果初始点有噪声，为什么不让模型稍微调整一下中心点呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors tested learned position offsets and found worse results, including blur and depth distortions in examples. Their interpretation is that appearance losses can encourage point movements that make particular training views look better without improving the scene’s underlying structure. The primary model therefore back-projects predicted depth to get centers, without offsets. This is a useful distinction: the system learns how each primitive contributes to an image, but does not use that learning to rewrite its geometry.
segments.zh: 作者测试了学习到的位置偏移，结果更差，示例中出现了模糊和深度失真。他们的解释是，外观损失可能会促使点发生移动，让某些训练视角看起来更好，却没有改善场景的底层结构。因此，主模型通过反投影预测深度来获得中心点，不使用偏移。这是一个有用的区分：系统学习每个基元如何对图像做出贡献，但并不利用这种学习去改写几何结构。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A second insight concerns camera alignment. In training, the model constructs points using predicted depths but uses ground-truth camera poses for input and target views. Since predicted depths and camera translations may have different scales, the authors normalize the point cloud and fit a scale between predicted and ground-truth camera trajectories. They preserve camera rotations and intrinsics. This reduces coordinate mismatch between the scene being rendered and the views used for supervision.
segments.zh: 第二个洞见与相机对齐有关。训练时，模型用预测深度构建点，但输入视图和目标视图使用真值相机位姿。由于预测深度和相机平移可能尺度不同，作者对点云做归一化，并在预测轨迹与真值相机轨迹之间拟合一个尺度。他们保留相机旋转和内参。这减少了渲染场景与用于监督的视图之间的坐标不匹配。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify why using predicted cameras for everything would not solve that mismatch?
segments.zh: 你能解释一下为什么全部使用预测相机不能解决这种不匹配吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Predicted cameras can be useful, especially when poses are unavailable at inference, but they may not match the ground-truth cameras used to supervise training images. A scene built in one frame and judged from another can receive misleading rendering feedback. InfiniSplat v2 aligns the training setup, then supports both pose-conditioned inference with supplied cameras and pose-free inference with predicted cameras. On the tested ablations, ground-truth camera back-projection improved results, including a reported 36.1% reduction in L-P-I-P-S on D-T-U.
segments.zh: 预测相机可能有用，尤其是在推理时位姿不可用的情况下，但它们可能与用于监督训练图像的真值相机不匹配。在一个坐标系中构建的场景从另一个坐标系评判，可能会收到误导性的渲染反馈。InfiniSplat v2对齐了训练设置，然后既支持使用所提供相机的位姿条件推理，也支持使用预测相机的无位姿推理。在测试的消融实验中，真值相机反投影改善了结果，包括在D-T-U上报告的L-P-I-P-S降低36.1%。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The third insight is to constrain Gaussians from more than nearby viewpoints. Training samples target views with a bias toward larger angular differences from the input cameras. Those views reveal when a Gaussian’s scale or orientation only works from one direction. The pipeline also merges redundant points in voxel groups and prunes low-opacity Gaussians. Ground-truth depth masks the target-view loss, focusing supervision on regions with valid support from at least one input view.
segments.zh: 第三个洞见是，不能只从邻近视角约束高斯。训练采样在选取目标视角时，会偏向与输入相机角度差异更大的方向。这些视角能暴露出某个高斯只在单一方向上才成立的比例或朝向。整个流程还会在体素组内合并冗余点，并剪除低不透明度的高斯。真值深度会为目标视角损失加上掩码，把监督集中在至少有一个输入视角提供有效支撑的区域。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does opacity simply become a learned way to remove unreliable points?
segments.zh: 不透明度是否就成了一种通过学习来去除不可靠点的方式？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is the evidence the authors investigate. Using ground-truth depth to classify points independently, they found that pruning at opacity 0.01 removed 51.8% of geometrically inconsistent points, while removing 7.5% of all points and retaining 93.3% of surface-consistent points. Opacity is not trained with an explicit inconsistency label; it emerges through image reconstruction supervision. So it can act as a filter, though it should not be mistaken for a complete geometric correction mechanism.
segments.zh: 这正是作者要考察的证据。他们用真实深度独立地对点进行分类，发现以0.01的不透明度阈值进行剪枝，能去除51.8%几何不一致的点，同时只去除全部点的7.5%，并保留93.3%表面一致的点。不透明度并非用显式的不一致标签训练，而是通过图像重建监督自然涌现出来的。因此它可以充当过滤器，但不应被误认为是完整的几何校正机制。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The practical payoff is fast scene production without optimizing each scene separately at inference. That could support visualization, simulation, or scene-understanding workflows where a user needs a renderable environment from a few photographs. Across six datasets, the feed-forward model had the lowest mean L-P-I-P-S and D-I-S-T-S among the compared methods in both pose settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, its mean scores were 0.2472 and 0.1163; in pose-free inference, they were 0.3026 and 0.1341.
segments.zh: 实际好处是能快速生成场景，无需在推理时对每个场景单独优化。这可以支持可视化、仿真或场景理解等工作流，用户只需几张照片就能得到一个可渲染的环境。在六个数据集上，无论哪种姿态设置，前馈模型在对比方法中平均LPIPS和DISTS都最低。在有姿态条件的设置下，其平均得分为0.2472和0.1163；在无姿态推理中，分别为0.3026和0.1341。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How much should we trust those comparisons, given the range of datasets and input views?
segments.zh: 考虑到数据集和输入视角的范围，我们该在多大程度上相信这些比较？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The evaluation spans D-L-three-D-V, E-T-H-three-D, N-R-G-B-D, Mip-NeRF 360, RealEstate10K, and D-T-U, with four, eight, or sixteen inputs. That breadth is useful, and comparisons include systems such as AnySplat, DepthSplat, and ReSplat. Still, the component ablations are limited to E-T-H-three-D and D-T-U, and results depend on the paper’s training and evaluation protocols. The gains are evidence for this design, not proof that it resolves every reconstruction setting.
segments.zh: 评估覆盖了D-L-three-D-V、E-T-H-three-D、N-R-G-B-D、Mip-NeRF 360、RealEstate10K和D-T-U，输入数量为四、八或十六个。这种广度很有用，对比中也包含了AnySplat、DepthSplat和ReSplat等系统。不过，组件消融实验仅限于E-T-H-three-D和D-T-U，而且结果取决于论文的训练和评估协议。这些提升是该设计的证据，但并不能证明它能解决所有重建场景。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The learned refiner adds another practical option. It renders the current scene, uses image feedback and gradients of rendering losses with respect to Gaussian attributes, and predicts updates through a recurrent spatial network. Those gradients inform its updates rather than being applied as ordinary gradient descent. The refiner keeps centers and point counts fixed, and uses three steps at inference. Its results are mixed: it improves both perceptual averages in pose-conditioned evaluation, but in pose-free evaluation the unrefined scene has slightly better mean D-I-S-T-S.
segments.zh: 学习到的精修器提供了另一种实用选择。它渲染当前场景，利用图像反馈以及渲染损失对高斯属性的梯度，并通过循环空间网络预测更新。这些梯度用于指导其更新，而不是作为普通梯度下降来应用。精修器保持中心和点数量固定，并在推理时使用三步。其结果好坏参半：在带位姿评估中，它改善了两项感知平均值，但在无位姿评估中，未精修场景的平均 D-I-S-T-S 略好。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does that learned refinement relate to ReSplat?
segments.zh: 这种学习到的细化方法与ReSplat有什么关系？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Both use rendered-image feedback to guide learned scene updates, but InfiniSplat v2 places that idea after a geometry-first, fixed-center construction. ReSplat is a relevant example of recurrent Gaussian refinement; here, the refiner is optional and changes attributes rather than geometry. The paper also reports that its refiner beats three-step Adam refinement on E-T-H-three-D across the listed metrics, while Adam makes only small changes. That comparison suggests learned update rules can use feedback more effectively in this setup.
segments.zh: 两者都用渲染图像反馈来引导学习到的场景更新，但InfiniSplat v2把这个思路放在了几何优先、固定中心的构建之后。ReSplat是循环高斯细化的一個相关例子；在这里，细化器是可选的，改变的是属性而非几何。论文还报告说，在所列指标上，其细化器在E-T-H-three-D上优于三步Adam细化，而Adam只带来很小的变化。这一比较表明，学习到的更新规则在这种设置下能更有效地利用反馈。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What remains the biggest limitation if the geometry prior fails badly?
segments.zh: 如果几何先验严重失效，最大的局限仍然是什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Fixed centers preserve the geometry branch’s predictions, but they also limit recovery from severe depth or camera errors. Sparse image coverage can leave unseen regions incomplete, and voxel grouping does not remove every redundant point. This frames the paper’s broader contribution as a refinement of feed-forward reconstruction, not a replacement for geometry estimation. Compared with approaches that chiefly change how Gaussians are placed, InfiniSplat v2 emphasizes how to learn their rendering attributes without letting appearance supervision distort the geometric scaffold.
segments.zh: 固定中心保留了几何分支的预测，但也限制了对严重深度或相机误差的恢复能力。稀疏的图像覆盖会导致未观测区域不完整，而体素分组也无法去除所有冗余点。这就把论文更宏观的贡献定位为对前馈重建的改进，而非对几何估计的替代。与主要改变高斯放置方式的方法相比，InfiniSplat v2 更强调如何学习其渲染属性，同时不让外观监督扭曲几何骨架。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that better novel-view rendering does not always require a more flexible geometry model. In this study, stable point centers, aligned camera supervision, and views from wider angles help the attribute learner produce more consistent scenes, while opacity can suppress some unreliable points. The remaining challenge is to correct substantial geometric errors and fill regions the cameras never observed. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，更好的新视角渲染并不总是需要更灵活的几何模型。在这项研究中，稳定的点中心、对齐的相机监督以及更广角度的视角，有助于属性学习器生成更一致的场景，而不透明度可以抑制一些不可靠的点。剩下的挑战是纠正重大的几何错误，并填补相机从未观测到的区域。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以询问我们的AI助手或留言评论。
